title: Lymphatic-Stromal Collagen Interface
notes: This region displays a spatially stratified pattern with dense, branching fibrillar collagen (SHG) concentrated at the upper stromal boundary and diffuse Podoplanin signal dominating the mid and lower tissue compartments. The collagen network forms a structured extracellular matrix layer consistent with desmoplastic stroma, while the broad Podoplanin coverage indicates abundant cancer-associated fibroblasts or lymphatic endothelium throughout the region. The spatial separation of these two signals marks a distinct stromal-lymphatic interface, suggesting active stromal remodeling at the tumor periphery.
